sections.overview: The catalogue name Megalaima australis is an older combination; current checklists treat the Java-and-Bali species as Psilopogon australis.
sections.identification: The green barbet has a blue crown and throat, a dark chest band, and conspicuous yellow ear-coverts and cheeks.
sections.habitat: This monotypic species is restricted to Java and Bali; forest is its principal habitat.
sections.diet: It is classed as mainly fruit-eating; its close island relative, the Flame-fronted Barbet, also takes insects and spiders.
sections.behavior: It is a resident forest barbet; detailed behavior is poorly documented for the modern, narrow species concept.
sections.reproduction: Nesting details in older accounts are difficult to separate from the formerly broader taxon.
sections.ecology: Like the Flame-fronted Barbet, it is an island forest barbet, but yellow ear-coverts distinguish it from that cousin’s orange-yellow forehead.
sections.conservation: Birds of the World lists it as Least Concern; this category does not establish that every local population is stable.
